description: Output quality evaluation test cases. Each prompt is a realistic user request; the agent should generate paste-ready Cypher for Neo4j Browser.

evals.prompt: Show me the full lineage of sem_wholesale.Margin_vw
evals.expected_output: Full upstream chain: Semantic → Gold → Silver → Replica → Operational → DataSystem → Server, plus downstream Reports and Data Analyst owner
assertions: Query is syntactically valid Cypher
Query uses DERIVED_FROM*1..5 for variable-length lineage traversal
Query uses OPTIONAL MATCH for hops beyond the anchor node
Query returns nodes and relationships (not scalar-only)
Result includes Table nodes from multiple layers
Result includes DataSystem and Server nodes in the upstream chain
All node labels used exist in the schema
All relationship types used exist in the schema

evals.prompt: Which reports consume data from Helios?
evals.expected_output: Reports connected via CONSUMES → Semantic ← DERIVED_FROM chain from DataSystem Helios
assertions: Query is syntactically valid Cypher
Query starts from DataSystem with name 'Helios'
Query traverses CONTAINS → REPLICATED_TO → DERIVED_FROM → CONSUMES
Query returns nodes and relationships (not scalar-only)
Result includes Report nodes
All node labels used exist in the schema
All relationship types used exist in the schema
